**结论：BERT 使用两个无监督预训练任务：① Masked LM（MLM，掩码语言模型）；② Next Sentence Prediction（NSP，下一句预测）。**

**依据文档**（知识库 `6789ebf9-…-ed1e92dc84ad`）：`实机演示-E2E-20261117-194145/bert-pretraining-demo.md`（BERT 原论文正文，以下均为 §3.1“Pre-training BERT”原文，P0 直接证据）

**1. 总述**
> “Unlike Peters et al. (2018a) and Radford et al. (2018), we do not use traditional left-to-right or right-to-left language models to pre-train BERT. **Instead, we pre-train BERT using two unsupervised tasks**, described in this section.”

**2. Task #1: Masked LM（MLM）**
> “**Task #1: Masked LM** … In order to train a deep bidirectional representation, we simply mask some percentage of the input tokens at random, and then predict those masked tokens. We refer to this procedure as a **“masked LM” (MLM)**, although it is often referred to as a Cloze task…”
> 实现细节：“we mask **15%** of all WordPiece tokens in each sequence at random”；被选中的 token 中 **80%** 替换为 `[MASK]`、**10%** 替换为随机词、**10%** 保持原样。

**3. Task #2: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP)**
> “**Task #2: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP)** … In order to train a model that understands sentence relationships, we pre-train for a binarized next sentence prediction task… **50% of the time B is the actual next sentence that follows A (labeled as IsNext), and 50% of the time it is a random sentence from the corpus (labeled as NotNext)**.”

**4. 交叉佐证（同一文档）**
- §5.1 消融实验：“**No NSP**: A bidirectional model which is trained using the “masked LM” (MLM) but without the “next sentence prediction” (NSP) task.”
- 附录 A.2：“The training loss is the **sum of the mean masked LM likelihood and the mean next sentence prediction likelihood**.” —— 这两个任务共同构成预训练总损失。

**同库其他副本**：`实机演示-E2E-20261117-194145/bert_pretraining.md`，以及 `计算机与人工智能/nlp__1810.04805__bert-pre-training-of-deep-bidirectional-transfor.md (part 1–3 of 3).md`（arXiv:1810.04805 论文的分片版本），其内容与上述一致，可作为第二来源。
